note: Forward plan, not history. Items have no dates or estimates because none are committed. An item moves to the timeline only when it is recorded in the repository. This list is edited by hand as the work changes. It does not show model or role activity.

items.title: Gate-push fix (4f77e2f)
items.state: complete on its own code line, not used by the LangGraph runtime
items.detail: Branch live/gate-push-binding (4f77e2f, built on the ledger commit 61ca8c9) makes git_push publish only the commit the gate approved, then checks every push destination. The final independent review accepted it with no defect for the race and verifier fix. This was an offline review of a public branch: it is not a rollout, a live run or a security certification. Source check: the execution code line (d4a7485) shares only an old common ancestor with this line and does not contain or call this executor, so there is nothing to integrate and no integration progress is claimed. Known limits: the branch tip is read once and not atomically, a single writer is assumed, and file-system and symlink trust are unchanged.
items.unlocks: Any use of this executor is a separate, later decision.
items.done_when: Complete as a fix on its own line. Wiring it anywhere would need its own reviewed change.

items.title: Budget ledger and pacing (61ca8c9)
items.state: offline accepted on the executor line, same scope as P1
items.detail: The scoped offline review of the ledger and pacing integration found no blockers. It lives on the same code line as P1 (61ca8c9) and is not used by the LangGraph runtime. It has not been used by a real run.
items.unlocks: A later, separate decision on live use of the ledger and pacing controls.
items.done_when: Accepted offline. Live use stays a separate decision.

items.title: Remaining WP4 and WP9 work
items.detail: From the work-package record: WP9 still needs the request-ID join and a matched savings comparison; WP4 and WP10 need the Reviewer-skip guard, which is still unbuilt. No dependency of these on P1 or P2 has been established, so none is claimed. Separate small fix, in review: the LangGraph coordination bus (execution line d4a7485) treated an errored push as not landed when it could not read the remote, and then reset its commit and retried. This was reproduced offline in disposable local repositories. A fix draft is on branch live/p1-bus-ambiguous-push (b0abb19, one commit on d4a7485): when the remote cannot be read the bus keeps the commit and stops, and retry stays only for a provable failure. The fix has passed its own offline tests and the project's 29 offline test files in one sandbox. It is not accepted until an independent review of that exact commit is recorded.
items.unlocks: Progress credit only when an independent review accepts the work.
items.done_when: Each item has its own accepted review.

items.title: Verifier and Ryan review cycle
items.detail: The one verifier attempt failed with HTTP 404 and no verdict. No model route is qualified for the verifier, and no next request is approved. One request remains in each of the runner and shared request limits (counted separately), which is not enough for a verifier plus Ryan's review.
items.after: A route that is callable and from a different lab, chosen through a reviewed change.
items.unlocks: A full research, verify and review cycle on the research backlog.
items.done_when: A cycle completes with a verdict and an independent review of it. Not planned for execution yet.

items.title: Handover to another AI
items.detail: The setup guide, state checker and fresh-environment test are built and pass offline in one sandbox. Nothing has been given to anyone. Private run records, if handed over, need a separate private route.
items.after: An authorized recipient and a private-transfer decision.
items.unlocks: A real recovery test by a second operator in a clean environment.
items.done_when: A second operator runs the guide's first two steps successfully.

items.title: Keep this plan current
